name: AVITO DOMINATOR — VISUAL QA PROTOCOL
principle: Первый кадр не обязан быть красивым. Он обязан выигрывать открытие объявления и приближать обращение.
release_rule: Ни один визуал не допускается к публикации, если провален PRODUCT, RECOGNITION, CTR, TRUST или SALES check. Финальный первый кадр для публикации должен набрать не менее 88/100.
global_forbidden: AI-generated coffee machines, vending machines, terminals, boards, assemblies or spare parts instead of real equipment
similar model instead of the model named in the ad
unverified random internet photo presented as the target model
trash, boxes, rags or bottles in the background
deep disassembly as the main first-frame object
equipment occupying less than roughly 40-50 percent of meaningful frame area
phone numbers, addresses or long offers on first frame
aggressive HDR, heavy filters or unnatural colors
repair visual that looks primarily like equipment-for-sale
